description: This file contains test setup code for creating mock store instances with different license features for integration testing in the Focalboard server project.

classes.name: TestStore
classes.description: A mock store used for testing, embedding store.Store and holding a license object.

methods.name: NewTestEnterpriseStore
methods.description: Creates a new TestStore instance with license features set for an enterprise license.

methods.name: NewTestProfessionalStore
methods.description: Creates a new TestStore instance with license features set for a professional license.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Returns the license associated with the TestStore instance.
